sentences.text: The species is known only from fossils found in the Lower Devonian Hunsrück slate of Germany.
It is tentatively classified as one of the most basal placoderms based on shoulder joint similarities, though this classification is debated.
Stensioella lived during the Emsian stage, between 410.62 and 399.5 million years ago.
Paleontologist Philippe Janvier suggests that Stensioella was a holocephalid rather than a placoderm.
